verses.text: Di Lord word come to Jonah, Amittai pikin, and e talk say,
“Rise, go Nineveh, dat great city, and cry out against am, because dem wickedness don reach me.”
But Jonah rise up to run go Tarshish from di Lord presence. E come down to Joppa, and find ship wey dey go Tarshish. So e pay im fare, and enter am, to go with dem go Tarshish from di Lord presence.
But di Lord send out great wind for di sea, and strong storm dey for di sea, so tay di ship nearly break up.

Den di sailors fear, and every man cry to im god. Dem throw di cargo wey dey inside di ship go inside di sea to make am light. But Jonah don go down inside di deepest part of di ship, and e lie down, and e dey deep sleep.
So di ship captain come to am and talk say, “Wetin you mean, you wey dey sleep? Rise, call your God! Maybe your God go notice us, so that we no go perish.”
Dem all talk say to one another, “Come, make we throw lots, so that we go know who cause dis evil wey dey on us.” So dem throw lots, and di lot fall on Jonah.
Den dem ask am, “Tell us, we beg you, because of who dis evil dey on us. Wetin be your work? Wia you come from? Wetin be your country? Which people you be?”
E talk say to dem, “Na Hebrew I be, and I dey fear di Lord, di God of heaven, wey make di sea and di dry land.”
Den di men fear plenty, and talk say to am, “Wetin be dis wey you don do?” For di men know say e dey run from di Lord presence, because e don tell dem.
Den dem talk say to am, “Wetin we go do to you, so that di sea go calm for us?” Because di sea dey rage more and more.
E talk say to dem, “Lift me up, and throw me inside di sea. Den di sea go calm for una, because I know say na because of me dis great storm dey on una.”
Still, di men row hard to carry dem go back to di land, but dem no fit, because di sea dey rage more and more against dem.
So dem cry to di Lord, and talk say, “We beg you, di Lord, we beg you, no let us perish because of dis man life, and no put innocent blood on us; because you, di Lord, don do as e please you.”
So dem lift Jonah, and throw am inside di sea; and di sea stop to rage.
Den di men fear di Lord plenty; and dem offer sacrifice to di Lord, and make vows.
Di Lord prepare one great fish to swallow Jonah, and Jonah dey inside di fish belly three days and three nights.
Den Jonah pray to di Lord im God from inside di fish belly.
E talk say, “I call to di Lord because of my suffering, and e answer me. From inside di belly of Sheol I cry. You hear my voice.”
“Because you throw me inside di deep, inside di heart of di seas. Di flood dey around me. All your waves and your big waves pass over me.”
“I talk say, ‘Dem don throw me out from before your eyes; but I go look again toward your holy temple.’”
“Di waters surround me, reach my soul. Di deep dey around me. Di weeds wrap round my head.”
“I come down to di bottom of di mountains. Di earth with im bars dey around me forever; but you don bring up my life from di pit, di Lord my God.”
“When my soul faint inside me, I remember di Lord. My prayer come to you, inside your holy temple.”
“Dem wey dey hold worthless idols dey leave dem own mercy.”
“But I go sacrifice to you with di voice of thanksgiving. I go pay wetin I don vow. Salvation dey belong to di Lord.”
Di Lord talk to di fish, and e vomit Jonah out for di dry land.
Di Lord word come to Jonah for di second time, and e talk say,
“Rise, go Nineveh, dat great city, and preach to am di message wey I give you.”
So Jonah rise, and go Nineveh, according to di Lord word. Now Nineveh na very great city, three days journey across.
Jonah begin to enter di city, one day journey, and e cry out, and talk say, “40 more days, and dem go overthrow Nineveh!”
Nineveh people believe God; and dem declare fast, and put on sackcloth, from di greatest of dem reach di least of dem.
Di news reach di king of Nineveh, and e rise from im throne, and remove im robe, and cover im body with sackcloth, and sit inside ashes.

E make proclamation and publish am throughout Nineveh by di decree of di king and im nobles, wey talk say, “Make nobody, man or animal, herd or flock, taste anything. Make dem no eat, and make dem no drink water;
But make dem wear sackcloth, both man and animal, and make dem cry out strongly to God. Yes, make each one turn from im evil way, and from di violence wey dey inside im hands.
Who know whether God no go turn and change im mind, and turn away from im fierce anger, so that we no go perish?”
God see dem works, how dem turn from dem evil way; and God change im mind about di disaster wey e talk say e go do to dem, and e no do am.
But e displease Jonah plenty, and e dey angry.

E pray to di Lord, and talk say, “I beg you, di Lord, no be dis na wetin I talk when I still dey for my country? So I hurry run go Tarshish, because I know say you na God wey get grace and mercy, wey dey slow to anger, wey get plenty loving kindness, and wey dey change im mind about doing harm.
So now, di Lord, I beg you, take my life from me, because e better for me to die pass to live.”
Di Lord talk say, “E right for you to dey angry?”
Den Jonah leave di city, and sit for di east side of di city, and for dat place e make one booth for imself, and sit under am for di shade, until e see wetin go happen to di city.
Di Lord God prepare one vine, and make am grow up over Jonah, so that e go be shade over im head, to save am from im discomfort. So Jonah glad plenty because of di vine.
But God prepare one worm for dawn di next day, and e attack di vine, so tay e dry up.
When di sun rise, God prepare hot east wind; and di sun beat di head of Jonah, so tay e faint, and e ask make e die, and talk say, “E better for me to die pass to live.”
God talk say to Jonah, “E right for you to dey angry about di vine?” E talk say, “E right for me to dey angry, even reach death.”
Di Lord talk say, “You don get pity for di vine, wey you no work hard for, and you no make am grow; wey come up for one night, and perish for one night:
And I no suppose get pity for Nineveh, dat great city, wey get more than 120,000 people wey no fit know di difference between dem right hand and dem left hand, and plenty animals too?”
